query: Which within-gallery randomization or temporal rolling designs most increase replication and what minimum detectable effects do they produce versus a 3-cluster design?

response.query: Which within-gallery randomization or temporal rolling designs most increase replication and what minimum detectable effects do they produce versus a 3-cluster design?
response.answer: Within-gallery randomization and temporal rolling designs increase replication more than a 3-cluster design. They typically detect smaller minimum effects due to their larger sample sizes. Stepped wedge designs are particularly effective.
